statement: Exactly 145 mixed genus-three finite subgroup classes have a spherical positive quotient with fixed-circle quotient involution; 57 are identified with B34 by explicit monodromy isomorphisms, leaving 88 new classes. All section data are computed.
manuscript_passages: Part B(f) of the task; genus-three mirror-disc quotient subcatalogue
depends_on_doubtful_reading: None: the quotient type and all covering homomorphisms are explicit.
notes: Exact source automorphism fusion proved by colored disc braids and boundary dihedral moves. The regular semidirect products, local injections, Euler characteristics and all sections were computed. The 57-row overlap is identified using canonical monodromy Cayley graph isomorphisms, not only matching counts.
